name: es-benchmark-prompts-refranes
description: A Spanish-language prompt dataset centered on refranes (proverbs) used to evaluate models' ability to retrieve, complete, or generate idiomatic and culturally grounded expressions. Measures language understanding and generation quality for proverb completion or retrieval tasks in Spanish. Useful for assessing cultural knowledge, idiomatic usage, and prompt-following in LLMs.
reputation: A niche, community-contributed dataset from the SomosNLP hackathon with limited but growing use for Spanish idiomatic-expression evaluation.
